# ART9: Music — Implementation Plan

**Goal:** all 14 pieces of 08 §14.3, generated by Python (no downloads, no copyrighted music), and a small music player in the Phaser layer that picks the piece per scene and plays it through the existing volume settings.

| Piece | Plays in |
|---|---|
| `title` | Title, menus, run summary |
| `village` | all 4 villages (including Home) |
| `plains`, `mountains`, `swamps`, `kingdom`, `castle` | stage music with Rush layers |
| `boss_guardian`, `boss_black_knight`, `boss_king`, `boss_dragon` | boss fights |
| `sting_victory`, `sting_death`, `sting_complete` | boss defeated, death, run completed |

**Spec:** `docs/spec/08-art-audio.md` §14 (music as note data + instrument samples + step sequencer) and §15 (mixing, unlock). Format decision follows the spec: JSON note data and 13 small WAV instrument samples, not compressed audio (the machine has no OGG encoder, and the spec says none is needed). Total music payload is about 0.6 MB JSON plus 1.3 MB samples (22,050 Hz mono).

**Starting point:** ART8 on `main`.

## Global constraints
- Only `tools/audio/`, `public/assets/music/`, `public/assets/audio/inst/`, `docs/art/`, `docs/plans/ART9*`, the `assets` flow in `tools/build_assets.py`, plus minimal Phaser-layer code in `src/game/audio/` and its scene calls. No `src/core/` edits (a code chat is building M10 there).
- Deterministic: seeded `numpy.random.default_rng(crc32(track id))`, no timestamps. `npm run assets` twice leaves git clean.
- Never copy anything into `tools/approved/`; the user approves by listening.
